canonical_refs.surface: A GUI burst opened while a human takeover lease is held: (a) POST /approvals/{aid} and POST /ui/approvals/{aid}/approve for an approved click/type/key, which is reachable once the snapshot quota turns GUI input into REQUIRE_APPROVAL or a policy gates GUI tools, and (b) POST /sandboxes/{sid}/tools/{click,type,key} whose pre-input docker commit races POST /sandboxes/{sid}/desktop/takeover. The burst is then closed by close_idle, which any agent tool call triggers, or by the next burst after handback.
canonical_refs.boundary: Agent GUI-burst enforcement (stray kill, gui_kept/gui_changes attribution) versus the human desktop session during a takeover: takeover closes the burst under gui_lock before installing the lease (service.py:571-589, close at 582), but _snapshot (service.py:261-277) closes and opens a burst without gui_lock or a lease check, reached from decide (service.py:440) and from call_tool after a needs_snapshot lease check (gui_bursts.py:55) that precedes a multi-second commit; an opened burst may survive the lease so close_idle (gui_bursts.py:154) or the next burst kills processes the human started or charges human edits to the agent.

canonical_refs.boundary: Disk-pressure guard and approval compaction (PR #20): call_tool refuses agent calls with 507 when free space on db_path.parent is below AGENTBOX_MIN_FREE, api.py skips the agent approval_forbidden row, _finish rewrites finished rows' args/preview to the bounded audit shape, decide maps claim sqlite3.Error to 503 and expire_stale stops on sqlite3.Error. canonical_refs.boundary: Audit-log tamper evidence across pruning: retention.prune drops and recreates the audit_no_delete trigger inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE, records an audit_anchor (last id/hash, archive sha256) and an audit_pruned row; verify() starts at the latest anchor and verify_archives() chains GENESIS -> archives -> live table. Invariant: a deletion or edit of audit history that the prune command did not perform is still detected, prune never removes pending/approved approvals or rows at/after the cutoff, and a failed prune leaves the database and archive consistent.
